notes: Identity verified from cover: Evaluating the replicability of social science experiments in Nature and Science between 2010 and 2015; Colin F. Camerer, Anna Dreber, Felix Holzmeister and the listed coauthors; DOI 10.1038/s41562-018-0399-z. Document is the authors’ Supplementary Information (methods, references, Tables 1–7, Figures 1–9), not an abstract or secondary report. No source PDF supplied. Target mapped by author/year and Table 1 hypothesis, not study-number equivalence or numeric matching. Only assigned unfinished fields completed; other fields are placeholders. Final outcome uses Stage 1 when replication stopped there and pooled Stage 1+2 when reported (two-stage procedure, p. 15). Authors explicitly mark Rep. as 'no' for this named study in the pooled Stage 1+2 results. This is their tabulated replication verdict, not a verdict inferred from p. Authors’ printed standardized replication correlation coefficient r retained. Requested test statistic is not supplied for this replication in the inspected study-result tables and relevant methods/protocol text; original-test statistics in Table 1 are not replication statistics. No conversion performed. The effect and p-value in the quoted replication columns describe the same test; p is unassigned and remains a placeholder. The r metric is explicitly documented in the table header and p. 18: 'We used the same measure of standardized effect sizes and transformed effect\nsizes into correlation coefficients (r) in the same way as done for the RPP 7 .'
